gaps.description: Symbol presence and manually closed statuses do not establish behavioral equivalence; the 2026-10-24 audit reproduces divergences against C++ 5.3.5.14.
gaps.pass_criteria: All open audit contract probes must pass as ordinary release tests; inventory completeness alone is insufficient.

gaps.description: Composite/FIX/NVFIX and header/message parsing paths handle invalid ranges and malformed wire data without panics.
gaps.pass_criteria: go test -count=1 ./amps/... passes parser/builder coverage tests.

gaps.description: LogonParams.Timeout is enforced during logon ack wait.
gaps.pass_criteria: go test -count=1 ./amps/... includes logon-timeout coverage and passes.

gaps.description: tcp/tcps URI compression=zlib and Client.SetCompression(true) enable compressed transport for regular and HA clients while rejecting unsupported transports.
gaps.pass_criteria: go test -count=1 ./amps/... passes transport compression coverage and parity docs describe the tcp/tcps-only contract.

gaps.description: File-backed stores use append/checkpoint persistence with crash-safe recovery semantics.
gaps.pass_criteria: go test -count=1 ./amps/... passes publish/bookmark store persistence tests.

gaps.description: Recovery ordering is deterministic: publish replay, resubscribe, retry/deferred callbacks.
gaps.pass_criteria: TestParityAuditSubscribeRecoveryGeneration and TestParityAuditResubscribeFailurePropagatesFromLogon pass in the ordinary suite.

gaps.description: A disconnect after recovery succeeds but before its worker releases ownership triggers another recovery.
gaps.pass_criteria: TestIntegrationHAReconnectAfterDisconnectAtSuccess passes with race detection, including forced disconnect during ReportSuccess.

gaps.description: A received processed ack stops its warning; a completed watcher cannot follow a replacement command, and fakeamps flushes acknowledgements before later queued data.
gaps.pass_criteria: The ack warning lifecycle regressions, TestConnWriterFlushesAcknowledgementBeforeQueuedData, FIFO/coalescing regressions and the expanded stress gate pass without increasing the 250ms warning threshold.

gaps.description: Pure-Go Kerberos compatibility authenticator is available through a dedicated package and existing Authenticator contract.
gaps.pass_criteria: go test -count=1 ./amps/... passes kerberos package tests.

gaps.description: CAPI SSL compatibility has stateful handle/context validation and deterministic error behavior.
gaps.pass_criteria: go test -count=1 ./amps/capi passes SSL compatibility tests.

gaps.description: Benchmark baseline and regression gate are available for hot-path operations.
gaps.pass_criteria: go run ./tools/perfgate validates benchmark deltas within threshold.

gaps.description: Parity acceptance and scope docs align with implemented behavior and gate commands.
gaps.pass_criteria: docs include gap register and parity acceptance workflow referencing machine gates.
